Titles.eng: Sunny Ryoko
Titles.jpn: 陽あたり良好!

Summaries.eng: Kishimoto Kasumi, a 15-year-old girl, was supposed to live at her auntie's house in order to go to high school since April. However, when she moved to the house she was surprised with the fact that there were already four new male students living in the same house. To make the matter worse, that day while she was taking a bath, Takasugi Yusaku, one of those boys, came into the bath and saw her naked. This is how Kasumi's troublesome high school days started.
Summaries.jpn: ４月から明条高校の１年生になる岸本かすみは、親元を離れて叔母が管理する下宿「ひだまり」で暮らすことになった。これから３年間の高校生活への期待に胸を膨らませるかすみだったが、「ひだまり」には同じ高校の４人の新入生男子も下宿することに。そして引越し初日、かすみは下宿の風呂場で、３号室に入ることになったクラスメートの高杉勇作と最悪な出会いをしてしまう。

Titles.eng: Hiatari Ryoko! Yume no Naka ni Kimi ga Ita

Summaries.eng:
The movie starts out with Katsuhiko going to the US, with Kasumi and Yusaku seeing him off at Narita.

Two years later, Katsuhiko is a professional racer, and comes back to Japan to race (and to marry Kasumi). Yusaku's hobby is photography.

Titles.eng: Kasumi and Yusaku Meet...in the Bath?!
Titles.jpn: かすみと勇作・出会いはおフロで…!?

Summaries.eng: Kasumi Kishimoto, 15 years old, is a freshman attending to Meijou High School from her aunt's house, which runs her boarding house. Her life has begun with her natural-blurred aunt and the four unique boarders.
Summaries.jpn: 岸本かすみ、15歳。下宿荘を営む叔母の家から明条高校に通う新入生。天然ボケの叔母、個性的な下宿人4人との生活が始まった。

Titles.eng: The First Storm of Spring! Who's the Boss of the Cheer Squad?
Titles.jpn: 春一番! 応援団のボスは誰?

Summaries.eng: Kasumi gets entangled by cheering team members at Meijou High School. At that time, Yusaku Takasugi, a boarder, appears. Yusaku is a friend who met a naked one in the bath!?

Titles.eng: Entrance Ceremony Pandemonium! The Shadowy Cheer Squad Appeared!!
Titles.jpn: 入学式大荒れ! でてきたぞ影の応援団!!

Summaries.eng: Kasumi and Yusaku Takasugi become classmates. Kasumi says she will join the track and field club, and Yusaku will join that cheering squad. Yusaku wants to support people who work hard!

Titles.eng: Kasumi in Danger! The Cheer Squad Leader Has a Secret
Titles.jpn: かすみがあぶない! 応援団長には秘密があるぞ

Summaries.eng: Yusaku is ordered by the cheerleader Sakamoto to bring Kasumi, but he gets feverish and collapses. Yusaku who saw Kasumi being taken from the health room...

Titles.eng: The Squad Leader's Misgivings: What Kind of Guy is the Mysterious Man Kodama
Titles.jpn: 団長の疑惑・謎の男児玉は一体何者だ

Summaries.eng: Is Sakamoto, the cheerleader, really bad? He had a cute hairpin labeled "Michiko". It's something strange.

Titles.eng: Yusaku Raids the ōendan!? The Squad Leader Mystery Is Solved
Titles.jpn: 勇作・応援団に殴り込み!? 団長の謎は解けたゾ

Summaries.eng: Kodama, the person Sakamoto caused the violence, called Sakamoto again. Kodama seems to be the lover of Michiko Takagi, the owner of the hairpin that Sakamoto had.

Titles.eng: Let's rebuild the baseball club! His heart swore to the setting sun
Titles.jpn: さあ野球部をたて直せ! 夕日に誓ったあいつの心

Summaries.eng: Sakamoto filed a dropout notice, and Yusaku, who was entrusted with the group, was enthusiastic. The favorable Keiko's older brother Seki, the ace of the baseball club, asked him to make the baseball club even more exciting.

Titles.eng: Kasumi in a rookie battle full of haze scratches! Yusaku's cheering song
Titles.jpn: かすみ傷だらけの新人戦 とどけ! 勇作の応援歌

Summaries.eng: Yusaku invites Kasumi to the manager of the baseball club, but she didn't feel like devoting herself to athletics. However, she looks like Yusaku who supports people.

Titles.eng: The baseball club is in a pinch!! The first practice game
Titles.jpn: 野球部がピンチだ!! 初めての練習試合

Summaries.eng: Kasumi, who became the manager of the baseball club, puts thirst on the members. Such a baseball club has a chance to play a practice match with a prestigious school that is a candidate for victory.

Titles.eng: What, Yusaku is joining the baseball club!? Captain Seki's fierce knock
Titles.jpn: エッ 勇作が野球部に!? キャプテン関の猛ノック

Summaries.eng: Yusaku decides to take the place of the injured center. He's trying hard, but it doesn't work. However, Seki knew the nature and guts of Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Keiko's passion is...a date for just two people
Titles.jpn: 圭子の熱い想いは…二人だけのデート

Summaries.eng: Keiko is worried about the relationship between Kasumi and Yusaku. She takes the courage to invite Yusaku to a concert. Kasumi devotes herself to her housework, but she becomes concerned about Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Great confusion! Kasumi and Keiko's love's uniform #8
Titles.jpn: 大混乱! かすみと圭子の愛の背番号8

Summaries.eng: The combination of summer qualifying tournaments has also been decided, and the practice of the baseball club has also become enthusiastic. It's the last summer for captain Seki... he had a special thought.

Titles.eng: A miracle!? Meijou baseball club, 1st round goodbye wins
Titles.jpn: 奇跡!? 明条野球部・1回戦サヨナラ勝ち

Summaries.eng: It's the first round of the summer Koshien qualifying tournament. Kasumi encourages the nervous members. Her lover "Katsuhiko" will return from America during the summer vacation.

Titles.eng: What happened to Yusaku?! Now Koshien anyway!
Titles.jpn: どうした勇作?! 今はとにかく甲子園!

Summaries.eng: It's raining on the first round. The Meijou baseball club, which defeated Torijou High School, was enthusiastic about the second round. At that time, Yusaku was asked by Mikimoto about his feelings for Keiko.

Titles.eng: I'm sorry, Katsuhiko! Only tonight with him...
Titles.jpn: ゴメンネ克彦さん! 今夜だけあいつと‥‥

Summaries.eng: It's quarterfinals for the members who are proud of their time. Kasumi and Yusaku don't talk about each other, but they bother each other. Kasumi takes care of Yusaku who was injured in the game all night.

Titles.eng: We can't lose! The semi-final where Kasumi burns!
Titles.jpn: 負けられない! かすみも燃える準決勝!

Summaries.eng: It's finally the semi-final. Kasumi worries about Yusaku who behaves well. Her last night with Yusaku flickers during the phone call from Katsuhiko. Yusaku's appearance is still Kasumi.

Titles.eng: Do your best today! The hottest finals!
Titles.jpn: 今日を精一杯! 熱くなりそな決勝戦!

Summaries.eng: Finally advanced to the final! Yusaku was participating in the cheering party, but he's dying for Kasumi's lover "Katsuhiko" to return to Japan.

Titles.eng: Look, Katsuhiko! The final match!
Titles.jpn: 見ていて克彦さん! 思いっきり決勝戦!

Summaries.eng: In the middle of the final match, Katsuhiko suddenly appeared. Yusaku, who was looking at the joyful Kasumi from the mound, missed the ball he could get.

Titles.eng: Why? Whose blame for the unstoppable tears
Titles.jpn: どうしてなの? とまらない涙は誰のせい

Summaries.eng: They lost the final game, but they have no regrets. They have a disappointing party with the usual noodles. However, Katsuhiko also participates there. Katsuhiko is conscious of Yusaku to Kasumi who praises Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Let me kiss you! The midsummer sea is full of danger
Titles.jpn: キスさせて! 真夏の海は危険がいっぱい

Summaries.eng: It's summer vacation. The aunt drove to the sea and everybody enjoyed being divided into couples. Suddenly, a girl named Maria, appears in front of Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Only one afternoon, the swaying heart is also the highest temperature
Titles.jpn: 一人だけの午後 ゆれるハートも最高気温

Summaries.eng: The aunt invited Shinichiro, who had become close to him at the beach, to a barbecue. His daughter who appeared with him was Maria who tried to kiss Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Head-on collision!? Declaration of two rivals to be worried about
Titles.jpn: 正面衝突!? 気になる二人のライバル宣言

Summaries.eng: Yusaku and the other boarders all went home, and Kasumi was alone with Katsuhiko. However, she is worried about Yusaku.

Titles.eng: When can we meet? The last fireworks with prayer
Titles.jpn: いつ会える? 祈りをこめて最後の花火

Summaries.eng: Katsuhiko, who declared his rival to Yusaku, "I will propose to Kasumi," has to go back to America. What is Katsuhiko who talks about his passion for baseball?

Titles.eng: Hot airmail, I don't listen to your heart now
Titles.jpn: 熱いエアメイル 今はハートを聞かないで

Summaries.eng: After returning to America, Katsuhiko recalled the days he spent with Kasumi and his encounter with Yusaku. Kasumi's feelings for her lover are beginning to lean toward Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Don't get me wrong! I'm just a housemate
Titles.jpn: 誤解しないで! ただの同居人なんだから

Summaries.eng: On Sunday, when the summer vacation is over, Kasumi, who is awakened early in the morning due to the commotion of the housemates, is in a bad mood and collided head-on with Yusaku on the stairs! Why does she get mad?

Titles.eng: Do you want to date? Who is in Yusaku's cheering squad?
Titles.jpn: デートさせたいの? 勇作は誰の応援団

Summaries.eng: Yusaku, who was listening to the late-night broadcast, happened to hear a love call to Kasumi. Is that person the 4th ace they met at the coin laundry?

Titles.eng: Don't worry! A strange date he set up
Titles.jpn: 心配無用! あいつが仕組んだ奇妙なデート

Summaries.eng: Kasumi has decided to date the ace no. 4 Takanezawa because of Yusaku who bought the role of Cupid. The shadow of Yusaku at the meeting place!?

Titles.eng: My heart is also a storm, alone with him tonight
Titles.jpn: ハートも暴風雨 今夜はあいつと二人きり

Summaries.eng: After this day a typhoon is coming. Kasumi and Yusaku is now alone in the boarding house. Somehow they become conscious of each other and become awkward.

Titles.eng: Eh, Miss the Autumn Tournament? What happens to the Baseball Club
Titles.jpn: えッ秋季大会に欠場? どうなるの野球部

Summaries.eng: The baseball team is told by the coach that they will not participate in the autumn tournament. Yusaku of the cheering squad protests directly to the principal! Kasumi also came there. Is Koshien a demon gate?

Titles.eng: The baseball club in a pinch! We can't keep silent
Titles.jpn: 野球部ピンチ! 黙って見てはいられない

Summaries.eng: Members who were told that they could not participate in the official game without the cooperation of the school. They have to do something about it! Yusaku started to move for the baseball club again.

Titles.eng: Eh!? That person? The new coach on the suit decided
Titles.jpn: えっ!? あの人が? スーツで決めた新監督

Summaries.eng: Yusaku and Kasumi's enthusiasm was transmitted to the school side, the members were gathered again, and the baseball club was appointed as a new coach. A transfer student came to the two classes.

Titles.eng: Sounds interesting, Coach Katsuhiko's first practice
Titles.jpn: おもしろそうね 監督克彦さんの初練習

Summaries.eng: The new coach of the baseball club was Kasumi's lover Katsuhiko. He said he came back from America because he wanted to play baseball, but he also wanted to marry Kasumi.

Titles.eng: Finally the autumn tournament! What is the strength of the new baseball club?
Titles.jpn: いよいよ秋季大会 新生野球部の実力は?

Summaries.eng: Kasumi was upset when Katsuhiko returned to Japan and couldn't concentrate on the practice of the track and field club. Meanwhile, the first round of the baseball club's autumn tournament, the debut match of new coach Katsuhiko has begun.

Titles.eng: Dissatisfied explosion? A baseball club that can't play baseball
Titles.jpn: 不満爆発? 野球ができない野球部なんて

Summaries.eng: Katsuhiko, the new coach returning from America, said he would go to the pool. Members who swim without touching the pole. Why are they swimming when they are in the baseball club?

Titles.eng: Passing theater festival, why don't you know, Yusaku?
Titles.jpn: すれ違い演劇祭・なんで勇作は知らん顔?

Summaries.eng: The theater festival season has arrived. The theme is "Romeo and Juliet". The protagonists are Yusaku and Kasumi. However, Yusaku suddenly drops off and starts a part-time job.

Titles.eng: Kasumi, I'm Sorry: Santa's Gift
Titles.jpn: かすみちゃんゴメン・イキなサンタの贈り物

Summaries.eng: Everybody decided to have a Christmas party at Maria's house. Kasumi goes shopping with Yusaku, but Yusaku who broke up on the way does not come back easily.

Titles.eng: High Expectations! Kasumi and Yusaku as Quiz Participants
Titles.jpn: 期待が重い! クイズに出場 かすみと勇作

Summaries.eng: December. Kasumi and the boarders who are supposed to go home have changed their schedule!? Her aunt applied for the high school couple tournament of the quiz show without permission and won the prize.

Titles.eng: Feelings That Tremble Both Body and Mind, The Cold Wind Tournament
Titles.jpn: 身も心も震える思い・寒風のガマン大会

Summaries.eng: Club competition "cold patience tournament". The representative of the cheering squad is Yusaku, and the baseball club is Ariyama. Every year, they decide to participate in a harsh competition that some people faint.

Titles.eng: I want to hear the real intention! At this rate, the two of us...
Titles.jpn: 本音が聞きたい! このままじゃ二人は…

Summaries.eng: After the cold weather tournament, everyone in the boarding house except Kasumi caught a cold. When Kasumi visited Katsuhiko, Maria was there.

Titles.eng: Yusaku's spirit without five people! Save the weak kendo club
Titles.jpn: 気迫の勇作五人抜き! 弱体剣道部を救え

Summaries.eng: Yusaku, who is a good friend, was asked by the kendo club, which is said to be the weakest in the prefecture, and decided to participate in the game. It is a promising Yusaku, but there was a formidable newcomer at the partner school.

Titles.eng: Incandescent Tour: Take Kasumi Skiing
Titles.jpn: 白熱ツアー・かすみをスキーにつれてって

Summaries.eng: Everybody decided to go to a ski lodge run by Mikimoto's uncle. It is said that Ariyama will not go while everyone is excited about skiing.

Titles.eng: Distress...!? Tell them you like them before you die!
Titles.jpn: 遭難……!? 死ぬ前に好きだと言って!

Summaries.eng: Kasumi together with all the others came to the ski resort. Keiko cares about Ariyama who refrains. Yusaku goes looking for Kasumi who has left alone.

Titles.eng: I like both! Kasumi with a delicate swaying heart
Titles.jpn: どっちも好き! ゆれるハートが微妙なかすみ

Summaries.eng: Kasumi tells Yusaku that she likes it. She can't tell Katsuhiko, who has been able to talk about anything at the ski resort, and her heart begins to get confused.

Titles.eng: The burning baseball club, we are secret weapons!?
Titles.jpn: 燃えちゃった野球部・俺たちが秘密兵器!?

Summaries.eng: "Don't run away from your feelings," says Yusaku from Katsuhiko. On the other hand, Kasumi heard that Katsuhiko refused an unexpected practice match.

Titles.eng: If you hit it, hit it! The men's game: Katsuhiko vs. Yusaku
Titles.jpn: 打つなら打ってみろ! 男の勝負 克彦対勇作

Summaries.eng: Members who burn in the red and white game in the team. It was a match where they can feel the results of the practice, and the quality of Yusaku was also evaluated. Katsuhiko joined as a pitcher there.

Titles.eng: Yusaku goes to the baseball club!? Kasumi is in the cheering squad this time
Titles.jpn: 勇作が野球部へ!? 今度はかすみが応援団

Summaries.eng: It's a serious match between Katsuhiko and Yusaku. Katsuhiko asks "Is it regrettable?" to Yusaku who lost in a splendid strikeout. Isn't Yusaku really wanting to play baseball?

Titles.eng: Kasumi transferred to another school!? Can she leave as it is?
Titles.jpn: かすみが転校!? このまま離れてもいいの?

Summaries.eng: An express delivery from her mother arrived at Kasumi. The content was that she might transfer to another school due to the circumstances of her parents' home. She is worried about her friends and Yusaku.

Titles.eng: Goodbye memories, smiles and tears don't suit
Titles.jpn: さよなら想い出・笑顔に涙は似合わない

Summaries.eng: Kasumi decided to transfer to another school. Four of her boarding house friends who lived under the same roof held a bright farewell party. Yusaku, everyone, thank you!
